name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-availability-calendar
title: Team Availability Calendar
shortDescription: Shows team vacations and absences from a SharePoint list on a month calendar, with multi-day bars, lane stacking for overlaps, an 'Out this week' strip and a per-person details panel. No Microsoft Graph permissions required.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework web part that shows team vacations and absences on a month calendar. Each absence is a coloured bar spanning its days; overlapping absences stack onto separate rows, and a '+N more' button opens the rest of a busy day. An 'Out this week' strip names everyone away in the next seven days, and selecting a bar or a day opens a details panel with the person, absence type, date range, notes and one-click Email and Teams buttons. The web part reads one plain SharePoint list with PnPjs - the list title and every column's internal name are configurable in the property pane - and needs no Microsoft Graph permissions, no tenant-admin API approval and no Azure Function. A 'Use sample data' toggle renders bundled demo absences so the layout can be previewed before the list exists.
